name: OpenMetadata
target: Catalog identity, lineage and declared quality metadata; no causal estimator.
reason: Retain catalog semantics and original APIs as references; require immutable snapshots, causal extension and read-back reconciliation before native admission.
uncertainty_contract: Catalog status carries declarations; it does not derive causal identification or uncertainty.
Scientific and institutional acceptance remain separately reviewed.

alternatives.route: Existing bank catalog through original APIs
alternatives.reason: Avoid redundant institutional ownership while preserving versioned evidence.
Own exact schema/client/status compatibility when deployment requires it.
Qualify mapper and causal-facet preservation before reuse.
Test semantic identity cheaply before server deployment.

alternatives.route: Whole catalog port or mandatory duplicate catalog
alternatives.reason: No demonstrated benefit offsets migration and maintenance obligations.

alternatives.route: Treat catalog lineage as causal acceptance
alternatives.reason: Metadata association and schema validity cannot establish scientific truth.

costs.prices: Unavailable;60USD witness is stipulated, not quoted
categories: scientific review and full failed-request costs

owners.obligation: Approve causal target, clocks, uncertainty and acceptance
Freeze server/mapping and own read-back failures
Preregister generated/public trials and full costs

revisit_trigger: Named catalog/server/client profile, reviewed causal extension and snapshot binding, solved environment/rights and registered permission/filtering/partial-write/retry tests.
limitations: Selected static source and authored declarative fixtures only; no upstream client/server/test executed.
Schema validity, server retention, persistence, causal identification and scientific acceptance are distinct.
Full generic-schema compatibility is unqualified: unused Java regex fails Python metaschema checking; raw bytes preserved.
Pinned development identity and direct Apache declaration do not establish supported distribution, transitive rights, environment or SLA.
Reference-only; integration_allowed=false and capabilities empty; visual, independent, bank and final acceptance open.
